svg.desc: Human words per month in 2026 and share by source: Codex 315,164 (48.7%), Obsidian notes 171,927 (26.6%), Claude Code 95,868 (14.8%), Dia 32,615 (5.0%), ChatGPT 31,033 (4.8%).
